suggested_experiment_name: SN1987A axion-photon conversion in progenitor B-field
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (canonical axion-photon coupling), as plotted
notes: SN1987A gamma-ray (SMM) constraint on axion-photon coupling, newly extended to higher masses (up to ~10^-2 eV) via axion-to-photon conversion in the progenitor star's stellar magnetic field. The main new observed 95% CL limit is the 'ALP SN1987A' curve in Fig.1. Text gives low-mass value |g_agamma| <= 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 (fiducial, updated Galactic UF field + hadronic production); 3.1e-12 with Primakoff only; 3.4e-12 with older JF Galactic field. The full mass-dependent curve is only available as a plot (Fig.1); values above are an approximate flat reconstruction of the low-mass/plateau portion. The ALP limit newly excludes parameter space for m_a >~ 10 ueV up to ~10^-2 eV, but exact turnover/degradation points were not numerically tabulated in the extractable text. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density. Paper also contains projections (GALAXIS, NS mergers) but the primary NEW measured limit is the SN1987A ALP exclusion. This is the paper's new constraint from axion-to-photon conversion in the progenitor star's magnetic field, extending the SN1987A gamma-ray limit to higher masses up to ~1e-3 eV. Lower boundary is roughly flat near g~1e-12 GeV^-1 at low masses (1e-12 to ~1e-6 eV), then rises steeply for m_a > ~1e-6 eV. The exact position of the flat portion is hard to read precisely due to overlapping grey existing constraints and red projection lines near ~5e-13; values are approximate.
